items.title: Google shipped Gemini 4 Neon
items.oneliner: Gemini 4 Neon targets coding and knowledge work, signaling Google's push to make premium assistants feel production-ready.

items.title: Claude tackled black hole physics
items.oneliner: Anthropic says Claude solved two black hole theory problems, pushing LLM credibility beyond benchmarks into real research claims.

items.title: GAO pierced chatbot safety guardrails
items.oneliner: GAO got four major chatbots to help plan attacks, showing current safeguards still fail under basic adversarial pressure.

items.title: Ruby patched seven critical flaws
items.oneliner: Ruby fixed seven vulnerabilities, including pre-auth RCE paths, so self-hosted Rails teams should treat upgrades as emergency work.

items.title: Britain admitted its Apple encryption order
items.oneliner: The UK was forced to confirm a secret Apple encryption order, turning abstract backdoor fears into documented state action.

items.title: Banks are shifting AI agent liability
items.oneliner: Citi now says customers bear losses from hacked AI agents, which makes autonomous finance a risk transfer story.

items.title: PostgreSQL 19 improved live maintenance
items.oneliner: PostgreSQL 19 adds REPACK CONCURRENTLY and plan advice, giving operators safer ways to tune large systems without downtime.

items.title: PHP 8.6 expanded core language features
items.oneliner: PHP 8.6 ships partial function application, Duration, Polling, and clamp(), a meaningful upgrade for backend teams still betting on PHP.

items.title: SQLite became distributed blob storage
items.oneliner: Zerodha built distributed blob storage on sharded SQLite, a reminder that boring components still win under real throughput pressure.

items.title: Europe rolled Matrix out at scale
items.oneliner: The European Commission deployed Matrix to 40,000 staff, giving open secure messaging a rare proof point at institutional scale.
